usageNotes: Permanently deletes a named cluster-level firewall IPSet. By default the deletion fails if the IPSet still contains members; pass `force: true` to delete all members along with the set in one operation. Requires `Sys.Modify` on the root path — API tokens must have this privilege explicitly granted.
destructiveReason: Permanently removes the named IPSet and, when force is true, all of its member IP/CIDR entries — any firewall rules referencing this IPSet by name will break silently.
tips: Check for firewall rules that reference the IPSet by name before deleting; Proxmox does not cascade-update rules, so orphaned references can silently open or block traffic unexpectedly.
Use `force: true` only when you have confirmed no active firewall rules depend on the set members.
IPSet names must start with a letter and may only contain letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores (2–64 chars).
